mapper.select: SELECT p.profile_id, p.user_id, p.nickname, p.introduction, p.original_name, p.stored_name, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM profile_tbl p INNER JOIN user_tbl u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND u.user_status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM profile_tbl p INNER JOIN user_tbl u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.nickname = #{nickname} AND p.user_id != #{userId} AND u.user_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE profile_tbl p INNER JOIN user_tbl u ON p.user_id = u.user_id SET p.nickname = #{nickname}, p.introduction = #{introduction}, p.updated_at = NOW() WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND u.user_status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE profile_tbl p INNER JOIN user_tbl u ON p.user_id = u.user_id SET p.original_name = #{originalName}, p.stored_name = #{storedName}, p.updated_at = NOW() WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND u.user_status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE profile_tbl SET original_name = NULL, stored_name = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
